wet_lunar_initialize = {
  if = {
    limit = {
      NOT = {
        has_global_flag = wet_lunar_initialized
      }
    }
    set_global_flag = wet_lunar_initialized
    set_variable = {
      global.wet_lunar_range = 7
    }
  }
}
wet_lunar_display = {
  set_variable = {
    wet_lunar_next_pp = 50
  }
  set_variable = {
    wet_lunar_next_civs = 5
  }
  set_temp_variable = {
    wet_lunar_price_increment = wet_lunar_uses
  }
  multiply_temp_variable = {
    wet_lunar_price_increment = 10
  }
  add_to_variable = {
    wet_lunar_next_pp = wet_lunar_price_increment
  }
  add_to_variable = {
    wet_lunar_next_civs = wet_lunar_uses
  }
}
wet_lunar_start = {
  wet_lunar_initialize = yes
  if = {
    limit = {
      tag = U25
      NOT = {
        has_global_flag = wet_lunar_active
      }
      NOT = {
        has_global_flag = wet_lunar_impact
      }
    }
    set_global_flag = wet_lunar_active
    set_variable = {
      global.wet_lunar_range = 6
    }
    set_country_flag = wet_skv_fire_authorised
    set_country_flag = wet_skv_lunar_started
    V04 = {
      wet_lunar_display = yes
      country_event = {
        id = wet_lunar.1
      }
    }
    wet_lunar_display = yes
    country_event = {
      id = wet_lunar.1
    }
  }
}

        wet_lunar_days = 0
      }
      set_variable = {
        wet_lunar_reserved = 0
      }
      add_timed_idea = {
        idea = wet_lunar_weight_of_heavens
        days = 730
      }
    }
    U25 = {
      remove_ideas = wet_lunar_reservation_0
      remove_ideas = wet_lunar_reservation_1
      remove_ideas = wet_lunar_reservation_2
      remove_ideas = wet_lunar_reservation_3
      remove_ideas = wet_lunar_reservation_4
      remove_ideas = wet_lunar_reservation_5
      clr_country_flag = wet_lunar_cooldown
      set_variable = {
        wet_lunar_days = 0
      }
      set_variable = {
        wet_lunar_reserved = 0
      }
      set_country_flag = wet_skv_lunar_fired
      clr_country_flag = wet_skv_lunar_countdown
      clr_country_flag = wet_skv_world_project_active
      add_ideas = wet_lunar_horned_rat_ascendant
    }
    every_country = {
      limit = {
        exists = yes
        NOT = {
          tag = WST
        }
      }
      country_event = {
        id = wet_lunar.2
      }
    }
  }
}
wet_lunar_daily = {
  wet_lunar_initialize = yes
  if = {
    limit = {
      check_variable = {
        wet_lunar_days
        >
        0
      }
    }
    subtract_from_variable = {
      wet_lunar_days = 1
    }
  }
  if = {
    limit = {
      NOT = {
        has_country_flag = wet_lunar_cooldown
      }
    }
    set_variable = {
      wet_lunar_days = 0
    }
    set_variable = {
      wet_lunar_reserved = 0
    }
  }
  wet_lunar_display = yes
}
